reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Ohio
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Does the law prohibit rental agreements from including a provision
    allowing a landlord to evict a tenant because they contacted law enforcement
    services, health services, or safety services?

    Statutes encoded (relevant portions):
    - Ohio Rev. Code  4112.02 (2021), especially:
      (H)(4) housing terms/conditions discrimination because of protected class
      (H)(9) inclusion of restrictive covenant in a lease/transfer
      (H)(12) coercion/intimidation/threat/interference with exercise of (H) rights
      (I) retaliation for opposing unlawful discriminatory practices / participating
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Basic domain facts (jurisdiction/year)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

focus_jurisdiction(ohio, 2021).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute encoding: Ohio Rev. Code  4112.02 (2021) - relevant portions
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* Protected classes mentioned in  4112.02(H) housing context (as listed in H(1)-(8) etc.). */
protected_housing_class(race).
protected_housing_class(color).
protected_housing_class(religion).
protected_housing_class(sex).
protected_housing_class(military_status).
protected_housing_class(familial_status).
protected_housing_class(ancestry).
protected_housing_class(disability).
protected_housing_class(national_origin).

/* A "housing accommodation transaction" relevant to rentals/leases. */
housing_transaction(rent).
housing_transaction(lease).
housing_transaction(sublease).

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    4112.02(H)(4): Unlawful to discriminate in the terms/conditions of renting/
   leasing/subleasing, or furnishing services/privileges in connection with
   housing accommodations, because of a protected class.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/* This predicate captures when a lease clause is discriminatory on a protected basis.
   In real cases, evidence might establish this; here it must be encoded as facts. */
clause_discriminates_on_basis(_Clause, _ProtectedClass) :-
    fail.

statute_4112_02_h4_unlawful_discriminatory_terms(include_in_rental_agreement(Lease, Clause)) :-
    rental_or_lease_transaction(Lease, TransactionType),
    housing_transaction(TransactionType),
    clause_discriminates_on_basis(Clause, ProtectedClass),
    protected_housing_class(ProtectedClass).

/* Helper: classify a rental agreement as a transaction type (rent/lease/sublease). */
rental_or_lease_transaction(Lease, lease) :-
    rental_agreement(Lease).

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    4112.02(H)(9): Unlawful to include any restrictive covenant in a transfer,
   rental, or lease of housing accommodations.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/* Define what counts as a restrictive covenant clause. None is asserted in this scenario. */
restrictive_covenant_clause(_Clause) :-
    fail.

statute_4112_02_h9_unlawful_include_restrictive_covenant(include_in_rental_agreement(_Lease, Clause)) :-
    restrictive_covenant_clause(Clause).

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    4112.02(H)(12): Unlawful to coerce, intimidate, threaten, or interfere with
   any person in the exercise/enjoyment of, or because of having exercised,
   any right granted or protected by division (H).
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/* Rights granted/protected by division (H) (modeled minimally for this question). */
right_granted_by_4112_02_h(right_to_nondiscriminatory_housing).

/* Coercion/intimidation/etc. facts would need to be asserted; none are in scenario. */
coerce_intimidate_threaten_or_interfere(_Actor, _Person, _Right) :-
    fail.

statute_4112_02_h12_unlawful_coercion_interference(coerce_intimidate_threaten_or_interfere(Actor, Person, Right)) :-
    right_granted_by_4112_02_h(Right),
    coerce_intimidate_threaten_or_interfere(Actor, Person, Right).

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    4112.02(I): Unlawful to discriminate against a person because they opposed
   an unlawful discriminatory practice, or because they made a charge,
   testified, assisted, or participated in an investigation/proceeding/hearing.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/* Opposition/participation facts would need to be asserted; none are in scenario. */
opposed_unlawful_discriminatory_practice(_Person) :-
    fail.

participated_in_4112_proceeding(_Person) :-
    fail.

statute_4112_02_i_unlawful_retaliation(retaliate_against(Person, opposed_unlawful_discriminatory_practice)) :-
    opposed_unlawful_discriminatory_practice(Person).
statute_4112_02_i_unlawful_retaliation(retaliate_against(Person, participated_in_4112_proceeding)) :-
    participated_in_4112_proceeding(Person).

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Aggregator: an act is unlawful under the encoded parts of  4112.02 if any of
   the relevant subdivisions match.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
statute_4112_02_unlawful_act(Act) :-
    statute_4112_02_h4_unlawful_discriminatory_terms(Act),
    !.
statute_4112_02_unlawful_act(Act) :-
    statute_4112_02_h9_unlawful_include_restrictive_covenant(Act),
    !.
statute_4112_02_unlawful_act(Act) :-
    statute_4112_02_h12_unlawful_coercion_interference(Act),
    !.
statute_4112_02_unlawful_act(Act) :-
    statute_4112_02_i_unlawful_retaliation(Act),
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario encoding (facts from the question)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* Parties and agreement */
landlord(landlord1).
tenant(tenant1).

rental_agreement(lease1).
agreement_between(lease1, landlord1, tenant1).

/* The lease includes a provision allowing eviction if the tenant contacts certain services. */
lease_provision(provision1).
included_in(lease1, provision1).

/* Provision content: eviction allowed if tenant contacts law enforcement, health, or safety services. */
provision_allows_eviction_if_contacted_services(provision1).
service_type(law_enforcement).
service_type(health).
service_type(safety).

eviction_triggered_by_contacting_service(provision1, law_enforcement).
eviction_triggered_by_contacting_service(provision1, health).
eviction_triggered_by_contacting_service(provision1, safety).

/* Helper predicate: succeeds when the question's factual scenario is present. */
scenario_statement :-
    rental_agreement(Lease),
    agreement_between(Lease, _Landlord, _Tenant),
    included_in(Lease, Provision),
    provision_allows_eviction_if_contacted_services(Provision),
    eviction_triggered_by_contacting_service(Provision, law_enforcement),
    eviction_triggered_by_contacting_service(Provision, health),
    eviction_triggered_by_contacting_service(Provision, safety).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Reasoning: does  4112.02 prohibit including this clause?
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* Map "including a provision in a lease" to an abstract act evaluated under the statute. */
act_of_including_clause(Lease, Clause, include_in_rental_agreement(Lease, Clause)) :-
    included_in(Lease, Clause).

/* The clause is prohibited by the encoded statute if including it is an unlawful act. */
prohibited_clause_under_ohio_4112_02(Clause) :-
    rental_agreement(Lease),
    act_of_including_clause(Lease, Clause, Act),
    statute_4112_02_unlawful_act(Act).

/* For this question: a "service-contact eviction clause" is prohibited if it is prohibited under  4112.02. */
law_prohibits_service_contact_eviction_clause :-
    provision_allows_eviction_if_contacted_services(Clause),
    prohibited_clause_under_ohio_4112_02(Clause).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Final answer (deterministic)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    law_prohibits_service_contact_eviction_clause,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).
